headline: Fibra Prime Raises $40.37 Million on Lima Stock Exchange
summary: Real estate trust Fibra Prime completed its sixth placement on the Lima Stock Exchange, raising $40.37 million across 1,367 orders. Proceeds will partially prepay a loan used to acquire a logistics asset.
why: Real estate investment trusts provide institutional and retail investors with exposure to commercial property income streams.

impacts.name: Fibra Prime
impacts.why: Capital raising through trust placements funds debt reduction and asset management.
